name: Office Capybara
intro: A tie-wearing capybara who clocks in on time and regrets it on time.
creator: Capy Studio
style: thick clean dark outlines, flat colors

stickers.caption: OK
stickers.action: nods twice and gives a big thumbs up

stickers.caption: Nooo
stickers.action: bursts into huge cartoon tears, shaking

stickers.caption: Coffee
stickers.action: holds up a coffee mug and sips with eyes closed

stickers.caption: Busy
stickers.action: types furiously on a tiny laptop

stickers.caption: Wait
stickers.action: raises one paw asking to pause
